text: When in doubt, use Sie. It is the safe choice with strangers, officials, shop and library staff, lecturers, and anyone clearly older than you.

At German-speaking universities, students use du with each other straight away. Lecturers and professors usually say Sie to students and are addressed with Sie, although du is common in some departments and research groups. At a Stammtisch or a society evening people often switch to du after a few minutes, and an older person may use du to a student.
Many workplaces, shops and websites use du with everyone. If an older or senior person says Wir können uns gern duzen (“We can use du”), you may switch too. Do not offer it first to someone senior.
Mistakes are forgiven: a learner who says Sie too often is seen as polite, not stiff.
